messages.subject: Re: ggsave does not work with geom_boxplot
parts:
Check the help page for ggsave (?ggsave) and note the order of augments.

ggsave thinks that 'w' is your file and that 'boxplot.png' is your plot. Try: 
ggsave( "boxplot.png",tmp, units = "mm", width = 100, heigh = 100)

~R
